provenance.ballPolicy: Moxie-specific separate ball follows her right hand in a circular path behind the body and rises over her head before the tick21 release. Sprite figures have empty hands and contain no ball.
provenance.cleanupNotes: Generated smooth purple backdrop removed with Moxie-specific low-frequency RGB-contrast matte (Gaussian sigma38px; alpha fade contrast21–42); raw source retained. Isolated fifteen pose components during packing.

review.reviewNotes: Fifteen complete Moxie poses in 5x3 order; adult human face, pale skin, lavender eyes, gold-tied lavender ponytail and purple/silver uniform stay consistent. Arm traces behind the head, low behind the hip, forward and up through release to form a broad windmill. One-hand release frame12/tick21 followed by score, descent and landing. No ball is drawn; background cleaned and alpha isolation checked.

provenance.packaging: package-dunk15.py --isolate-components; 128x96 cells; baseline94; WebP88; no generated extra frames

repack.fit: uniform scale, never upscale; max 86px high and cell width minus 10px; centered horizontally and baseline aligned with 5px bottom clearance

runtimeTrackCalibration.source: human source-cell hand estimate; formulas documented in per-clip layout provenance
runtimeTrackCalibration.notes: Aerial contact points in frames8-10 calibrated from the visible Moxie hand and checked at last carried tick20 in both facings at standard and120% native Canvas zoom. Frame10 ball resolves at the rim on tick21. Raw source ballTrack remains preserved separately.

reviewNotes: Full atlas reviewed on dark and light backgrounds after margin normalization: separated complete human poses, clean alpha, at least5px vertical and horizontal clearance, no crop bleed, Moxie canon and no baked ball. Native Canvas action frames select this atlas in both facings at100% and120% zoom.
